migration_flags.description: report_template_ids is Many2many in v19 (relation: mail_template_ir_actions_report_rel). In v16/v17 this was a Many2one field named report_template_id. Migration must convert single FK to M2M join table.
send_mail_batch() is a new v19 public API. v16/v17 had no batch send method on mail.template. Callers relying on looped send_mail() calls can now use the batch version for performance.
template_category is a new computed Selection field (base_template/hidden_template/custom_template) not present in v16/v17. Dependent views or domain filters may need adjustment.
user_id (Owner) Many2one field is new in v19 on mail.template. Affects access control and ordering (_order includes user_id).
use_default_to field is confirmed present in v19 (default=True). No removal occurred. Migration concern is default behavior change risk only.
mail_server_id Many2one to ir.mail_server is confirmed present in v19 with index='btree_not_null'. No change from v16/v17 pattern.

scheduled_date on mail.template remains a Char field (dynamic expression). mail.mail.scheduled_date is Datetime. Parsing via _parse_scheduled_datetime() normalizes to naive UTC. Unchanged from v16/v17.
v19 introduces an optimization: templates with only safe object.field.subfield expressions use a regex renderer (no eval). This changes render performance profile but not functional output.

key_findings.model: ir.mail.template inherits mail.render.mixin and template.reset.mixin; _unrestricted_rendering=True with group-based unsafe-expression guard
key_findings.dynamic_fields: 9 fields rendered at send time: body_html (QWeb), subject/email_from/email_to/email_cc/reply_to/partner_to/scheduled_date/lang (inline_template)
key_findings.eval_context: object (record), user, env, ctx, format_date, format_datetime, format_time, format_amount, format_duration, format_addr, is_html_empty, slug, plus template_env_globals
key_findings.recipients: use_default_to=True delegates to _message_get_default_recipients(); False renders email_to/email_cc/partner_to dynamically; partner_to IDs validated via exists()
key_findings.attachments: Static attachment_ids (IDs copied directly) + dynamic report_template_ids (Many2many, rendered per record via ir.actions.report, base64-encoded)
key_findings.send_path: send_mail() -> send_mail_batch() -> _generate_template() per chunk -> mail.mail.sudo().create(batch) -> optional force_send
key_findings.mail_state_machine: outgoing(default) -> sent/exception/cancel; _send() preemptively writes exception before SMTP attempt, overwrites to sent on success
key_findings.auto_delete: mail.mail records with auto_delete=True (default) are permanently unlinked after successful send via _postprocess_sent_message()
key_findings.scheduled_queue: process_email_queue() fetches outgoing mails with scheduled_date<=utcnow or scheduled_date=False; batch size configurable via mail.mail.queue.batch.size

critical_migration_item: report_template_id (Many2one) in v16/v17 became report_template_ids (Many2many) in v19 — requires data migration of join table and view/code updates
